title: Personalization of gamification-elements in an e-learning environment based on learners' motivation
reason: LMS participation rates and quiz grades are compared between personalised and random gamification groups; AGQ-R motivation type is used only for assignment, never related per student to participation or success. Pilot survey links two self-reports.

extraction.n_quote: English was selected. 100 individuals of students participated
extraction.population: engineering students in a Technical English course, University of Tehran (pilot survey: 273 students)
extraction.lms_indicators: participation rate in forums and online quizzes (group means)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: achievement-goal motivation type (AGQ-R) used for assignment; exam/quiz grades
extraction.notes: Group difference in participation 79% vs 58%, t-test sig. = 0.024; this is a group-membership effect, not an indicator-outcome relation. 1-month study.
